title: Plugin-eval runner script with monitored logs; regenerate stale plugin-eval cases
description: User asked (2026-09-26) for the claude plugin eval commands in a script that writes to a known log location so the agent can monitor and review the run while the user runs it. The committed evals/cases predate TS-14's assertion changes and must be regenerated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: evals/run_plugin_eval.sh runs the trigger and/or task suites, writing a console log, JSON result, HTML report and a status file per suite to a known log directory with a latest symlink
evals/cases regenerated from the current evals/evals.json and committed
Runbook documents the script and where its logs go

finalSummary: evals/run_plugin_eval.sh runs the trigger and/or task suites of claude plugin eval via script(1). Per suite it writes a live console log, a --verbose trace (heartbeat), JSON, an HTML report and a status line to /tmp/test-skills-plugin-eval/<timestamp>/ (latest symlink), then writes DONE. It was smoke-tested on single trigger cases (exit 0, JSON and report written, status and DONE correct) and is bash-3.2 safe and shellcheck-clean. evals/cases were regenerated from the TS-14 assertions. The runbook and README document it. Delivered in the PR that closes this task.
